methodology.dailyReturn: Adjusted close-to-close percentage return from Massive daily aggregates.
methodology.storedMarketData: For stock, Nasdaq Composite and SOX, each row retains adjusted close, previous close and close-to-close changePct.
methodology.window: T-7 through T+7 regular trading sessions around the announcement-date session.
methodology.pre7: Compound return across offsets -7 through -1, excluding announcement day.
methodology.postEvent: Cumulative T+1 through T+n returns are stored for n=1..7.
methodology.timingNote: For after-close reporters, T0 is pre-announcement trading and T+1 contains the first regular-session earnings reaction. For before-open reporters, T0 already contains the first earnings reaction.
